restaurantName: La Table Cachée par Michel Roth
address: BHV, 33 rue de la Verrerie, Paris, 75004, France
bio: On the 5th floor of the BHV department store, this “hidden table” lies behind a mysterious green curtain - at the rear of the lingerie department! The cosy setting (all the “props” are sold in the store) is the lair of Michel Roth who crafts an enticing seasonal score (tartlet of haddock, magret of Gers duck with bigarade sauce, millefeuille pastry with Corsican clementines) and a reasonably priced first-class market-fresh menu at lunchtime. The panoramic terrace commands a fantastic view of the townhall of Paris....
pageTitle: La Table Cachée par Michel Roth
